item.title: Whiskers 0.8.51
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.51

### Recording Reliability

  • Improved Bluetooth microphone startup so recording begins on the first usable audio instead of waiting for the start cue to finish
  • Improved Bluetooth audio conditioning so quiet speech is boosted more naturally without over-amplifying silence or loud speech

    • ### Transcription Performance

  • Reduced transcription overhead during recording so dictation stays more responsive
  • Reduced memory growth in local and bulk transcription so longer sessions and model switches stay more stable

    • ### App Reliability

  • Improved transcript, licensing, support, and network checks so Whiskers keeps app state more consistent across launches
  • Improved background update checks so automatic update preferences work more consistently

    • ### Settings

  • Improved AI Enhancement settings layout with cleaner prompt cards and more consistent spacing across settings
